title: Tailwind in an Angular Native app
description: Sets up Tailwind in an Angular Native app, and the Tailwind-styled workspace libraries it uses.

project.description: The Angular Native app, or a browser app built with Vite and ngNativeWeb(). An app with both builds gets both set up.
project.x-prompt: Which app should Tailwind be set up in?

tailwindVersion.description: The Tailwind major: 4, or 3. Defaults to the one the workspace has, or 4.

library.description: Comma-separated workspace libraries whose classes the app uses: each gets a Tailwind theme of its own that the app loads.
